domain.doc: primitives: faces get the material (Blender's material slots, USD's bindings); points: the points do, which Scene Objects reads to give each instance its own material

group.doc: Which ones: group names, ranges or '@area > 0.1' (empty: all of them)

index_attrib.doc: An integer attribute on the same domain (a piece or id number, or one made by attribute_randomize) that picks from 'names'. Empty: every element gets 'material'

material.doc: Material name. In Blender the object's slot is filled with the material of that name (made if missing); in USD it becomes a material binding. Empty: back to whatever the target has

names.doc: Several names, separated by commas: with 'index_attrib', element number n gets the name at position n (counting from 0, wrapping around). Used instead of 'material'
